description: This PHP source file defines the WorkshopAdminController class within the Goteo framework. It manages administrative actions for workshops, including listing workshops, editing existing workshops, and adding new ones. It interacts with Workshop model objects, handles HTTP requests, and renders appropriate views.

classes.name: WorkshopAdminController
classes.description: Controller class for managing workshop administrative functions such as listing, editing, and adding workshops within the Goteo framework.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'services' for categorization.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines and returns the routing configurations for workshop admin actions.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Handles listing of workshops with pagination, fetching data from the Workshop model.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing and adding new workshops, processing forms, and deleting workshops if requested.
